FitOutLevel.description: Fit-out quality (§7.1). Post-v1 except as a stored field and its build-cost multiplier.

GrocerConfig.description: The Grocer's tunables (§10). Money is decimal pounds; shares are decimals.

cash_buffer.description:
Cash it keeps in hand: it never spends (land, buildings) below this balance, so the
06:00 bills don't take it under zero by midnight (R3).

initial_order_share.description: A new shop's first order, as a share of its capacity. Above 0, at most 1.

max_bid_share.description:
The most it will pay for a lot, as a share of its bid ceiling (`balance + credit
limit`, R7). Above 0, at most 1.

min_tier_weight.description:
Tiers whose `grocer` personality weight is at least this are worth bidding on
(`tier_low: 1.0` passes, `tier_high: 0.1` does not). Between 0 and 1.

opportunism.description:
When it moves into another line of business (R66). Shipped off: the Grocer stays pure
retail.

order_margin.description: Tomorrow's order = today's sales × (1 + this), capped at capacity (R2, R10). At most 1.

price_jitter.description:
Random spread either side of its price, from its own RNG stream. Below `1 −
working_class_discount`.

rescue_after.description:
From this time until midnight, a negative balance makes it sell a shop back to the
city (R5) rather than take a strike (R3). Must be after day trade closes.

shop_footprint.description: Footprint of each shop, `[width, depth]` in lot units.

shop_height.description: Height of each shop in units; capped at the type's `max_height` (R58).

shop_types.description: Day-trade shop types it builds, in rotation (`businesses.yaml` ids).

working_class_discount.description:
Working-class bias: price this far under the reference price (0.05 = 95% of
`ref_price`). At least 0, below 1.

LandlordConfig.description: The Landlord's tunables (§10). Tiers come from the `landlord` personality's weights.

aggression.description:
Strength knob: the most it pays for one lease, as a share of its bid ceiling
(`balance + credit limit`, R7). Above 0, at most 1.

apartment_footprint.description: Footprint of each apartment block it builds, `[width, depth]` in lot units.

apartment_height.description: Height of each apartment block; capped at the type's `max_height` (R58).

apartments_per_lot.description: Apartment blocks it puts up per lease at most (0: pure land, no building at all).

bid_jitter.description:
Spread of its keenness: each auction it scales its maximum bid by a factor drawn from
its own RNG stream in `[1 − bid_jitter, 1]`. Between 0 and 1.

max_leases.description: Leases it holds at most at once.

min_tier_weight.description: Tiers whose personality weight is at least this are worth a lease. Between 0 and 1.

rent.description: Its rent per flat, as a share of `customers.yaml` `residential.reference_rent` (R51).

rescue_after.description: From this time to midnight, a negative balance makes it sell (R5) or offer a lease.

sell_within_years.description:
Late in a lease (this many years or fewer left) it offers the lease at auction (R33)
when the reserve beats what holding to expiry is worth. 0 never sells.

OpportunismConfig.description:
When a personality leaves its home line of business for another that is earning more (R66):
the switch rule, the cap on how far it strays, and how it builds and lets apartments when it
does. The yields it compares are `ai::kit::line_yields`.

apartment_footprint.description: Footprint of each apartment block it builds, `[width, depth]` in lot units.

apartment_height.description: Height of each apartment block; capped at the type's `max_height` (R58).

apartments_per_lot.description: Apartment blocks it builds per lease at most (0: it never builds, it only buys).

cut_at.description: Occupancy at or below which it cuts the rent. Below `raise_at`.

enabled.description: Whether it ever leaves its home line.

fit_out.description: Fit-out of the blocks it builds (§7.1).

max_outside_share.description:
The most of its holdings (build cost of its buildings, plus its leases' book value for a
land dealer) it lets sit outside its home line. Between 0 and 1.

max_rent.description: The highest rent it sets, as a share of `reference_rent`.

min_rent.description: The lowest rent it sets, as a share of `reference_rent`. At most `max_rent`.

raise_at.description: Occupancy at or above which it raises the rent. At most 1.

rent_step.description: How far it moves the rent each morning, as a share of `reference_rent`. Above 0.

start_rent.description: A new block's rent, as a share of `residential.reference_rent` (R51).

threshold.description:
How much more the other line must earn per pound tied up before it moves in: `0.25`
means 25% more than its own line's daily yield. Between 0 and 10.

PennySugarConfig.description: Sir Penny Sugar's tunables (§10, §7.2). Tiers come from the `sir_penny_sugar` weights.

aggression.description:
Strength knob: the most he pays for one lease, as a share of his bid ceiling (R7).
Above 0, at most 1.

apartment_footprint.description: Footprint of each apartment block, `[width, depth]` in lot units.

apartment_height.description: Height of each apartment block; capped at the type's `max_height` (R58).

apartments_per_lot.description: Apartment blocks he puts up per lease at most.

bid_jitter.description:
Spread of its keenness: each auction it scales its maximum bid by a factor drawn from
its own RNG stream in `[1 − bid_jitter, 1]`. Between 0 and 1.

buy_city_blocks.description: Buys the city's apartment blocks at auction when he can (R28).

cut_at.description: Occupancy at or below which he cuts the rent. Below `raise_at`.

max_rent.description: The highest rent he sets, as a share of `reference_rent`.

min_rent.description: The lowest rent he sets, as a share of `reference_rent`. At most `max_rent`.

min_tier_weight.description: Tiers whose personality weight is at least this are worth a lease. Between 0 and 1.

raise_at.description: Occupancy (flats let ÷ flats) at or above which he raises the rent. At most 1.

rent_step.description: How far he moves the rent each morning, as a share of `reference_rent`. Above 0.

rescue_after.description: From this time to midnight, a negative balance makes him sell a block to the city (R5).

start_rent.description: A new block's rent, as a share of `residential.reference_rent` (R51).

station_premium.description:
Extra share of his bid ceiling he pays for a lot with an open tube station (§4.3). He
also bids on station lots first. Between 0 and 1.

description.description: One line on how it plays.

PersonalityWeights.description: Weights for the shared evaluation function.

risk.description: Willingness to bid high and run an overdraft.

SpeculatorConfig.description: The Speculator's tunables (§10). Tiers come from the `speculator` personality's weights.

aggression.description:
Strength (and risk) knob: the most it pays for one lease, as a share of its bid
ceiling (R7), which includes its credit. Above 0, at most 1.

apartment_hold_hours.description:
Game hours it holds an apartment block before re-listing it: long enough to collect
some rent (R51) first. Otherwise `hold_hours` applies.

bargain_share.description:
On an item a player offers (a lease part-way through its term, or a business), the most
it bids as a share of book value (land value, R39; build cost, R41). Above 0, at most 1.

bid_jitter.description:
Spread of its keenness: each auction it scales its maximum bid by a factor drawn from
its own RNG stream in `[1 − bid_jitter, 1]`. Between 0 and 1.

cash_buffer.description: Cash it keeps when it opens an auction: small, by temperament.

hold_hours.description: Game hours it holds a purchase before putting it back up for auction.

max_holdings.description: Leases and businesses it holds at most at once.

max_markup.description:
On a fresh lease from the city, the most it pays over the land base price (0.25 = 125%
of base): it has to sell on for more. Between 0 and 10.

min_tier_weight.description: Tiers whose personality weight is at least this are worth a punt. Between 0 and 1.

opportunism.description: When it buys, or builds and flips, apartment blocks (R66).

rescue_after.description: From this time to midnight, a negative balance makes it sell (R5) or offer a lease.

ToffConfig.description: The Toff's tunables (§10). Tiers come from the `toff` personality's weights.

aggression.description:
Strength knob: the most it pays for one lease, as a share of its bid ceiling (R7).
Above 0, at most 1.

bid_jitter.description:
Spread of its keenness: each auction it scales its maximum bid by a factor drawn from
its own RNG stream in `[1 − bid_jitter, 1]`. Between 0 and 1.

cash_buffer.description: Cash it never spends below (R3): large, by temperament.

initial_order_share.description: A new shop's first order, as a share of capacity. Above 0, at most 1.

min_tier_weight.description: Tiers whose personality weight is at least this are worth a lease (High only).

opportunism.description: When it moves into luxury apartments on its High-tier lots (R66).

order_margin.description: Tomorrow's order = today's sales × (1 + this), capped at capacity (R2, R10). At most 1.

price_premium.description: Prices this far over the reference price (0.3 = 130% of `ref_price`). Between 0 and 4.

rescue_after.description: From this time to midnight, a negative balance makes it sell a shop to the city (R5).

shop_footprint.description: Footprint of each shop, `[width, depth]` in lot units.

shop_height.description: Height of each shop; capped at the type's `max_height` (R58).

shop_types.description:
Shop types it prefers, best first (`businesses.yaml` ids). Only types unlocked and not
obsolete in the current year are built; when none of these is, it builds any available
retail type, dearest goods first.

shops_per_lot.description: Shops it builds per lease at most: fewer, finer shops.

decision_interval_ticks.description: Ticks between an AI player's decisions.

grocer.description:
How the Grocer plays (§10: "opens many cheap Low-tier shops"). Its tier choice comes
from the `grocer` personality's weights; these are its operating rules.

landlord.description: How the Landlord plays (§10: "hoards leases and never builds retail").

opponents.description: Personality ids seated by default (v1: one Grocer).

personalities.description: Personalities, keyed by id. All share one evaluation function with different weights.

sir_penny_sugar.description: How Sir Penny Sugar plays (§10: "deals mostly in residential", §7.2).

speculator.description: How the Speculator plays (§10: "bids hard and flips").

toff.description: How the Toff plays (§10: "only goes for High tier").
